# uzc_cloud_providers (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud cloud providers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_cloud_providers" "vm_capable" {
  service = "Virtual Machine"
}

output "cloud_provider_slugs" {
  value = [for p in data.uzc_cloud_providers.vm_capable.cloud_providers : p.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `service` (String) Filter to cloud providers that support this service (e.g. "Virtual Machine").

### Read-Only

- `cloud_providers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_providers))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
